# Sipiteno

> Strategic business development and technology consulting firm, founded in 2009, operating across 28 countries in Europe, Caucasus, and Central Asia.

## Company Overview

Sipiteno helps technology companies expand internationally through business development, AI consulting, IT solutions, and MicroSaaS MVP development. The company combines 15+ years of regional expertise with hands-on technical capabilities.

- Website: https://sipiteno.com
- Contact: sales@sipiteno.com
- Founded: 2009
- Team Size: 20-30 professionals
- Client Rating: 4.9/5 (50+ reviews)
- Projects Delivered: 50+

## Services

- [AI Consulting](https://sipiteno.com/services/ai-consulting): Strategy, ML implementation, intelligent automation. $25,000-$100,000+, 8-16 weeks.
- [Business Development B2B](https://sipiteno.com/services/business-development): Partnerships, lead generation, market entry. $3,000-$10,000/month retainer.
- IT Consulting: Digital transformation, infrastructure optimization, cloud migration.
- Digital Marketing: SEO, SEM, content marketing for B2B tech companies.
- MicroSaaS MVP Development: Rapid prototyping in 4-8 weeks. $15,000-$50,000 fixed price.
- Project Management: Agile/Scrum implementation and resource planning.
- HR & Technical Recruitment: Talent sourcing across Eastern Europe and Central Asia.

## Geographic Coverage (28 Countries)

Eastern Europe: Ukraine, Poland, Serbia, Czech Republic, Romania, Bulgaria, Croatia, Slovenia, Slovakia, Hungary, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Albania, Moldova
Caucasus: Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan
Central Asia: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan
Other: Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Cyprus, Greece, India, Ethiopia
